text: Subjective: 82-year-old living alone reports increasing dizziness and occasional falls over the past month. Takes multiple medications including antihypertensives, benzodiazepine at night, and over-the-counter sleep aids. Objective: Orthostatic drop in blood pressure, mild gait instability, no focal neurologic deficit. Plan: Perform comprehensive medication review, deprescribe high-risk sedative medications, adjust antihypertensive doses, discuss fall prevention strategies, and coordinate follow-up with primary care and pharmacy.
